stem: Which of the following was a major contribution of the Harlem Renaissance to U.S. culture?

options.label: A
options.text: It led to the increased popularity of vaudeville stage performers.

options.label: B
options.text: It brought the most significant beat poets together.

options.label: C
options.text: It established jazz as a prominent musical form.

options.label: D
options.text: It focused attention on the antiwar literary genre.
